title: The Seed Casts Twice
summary: Noir paper street. The theft is already over; the second cast is still happening. A child's shadow stays planted on the third step and blooms into a fractal garden. Breath iterates the plants; a hold withdraws them; a flat seed-disc drops into the palm. Lotte Reiniger table, Desmet amber field. Not Daisy. Ladies off the street.
visualArc: Empty street + orphan shadow → child matched then split → canopy hides the disc → hold withdraws branches → disc on the palm, shadow locks.
